summary: Summons pass through: a PaceRule.passes flag shrinks facility.enter to gather 715 + act 1200 (1915 ms, from 4835 with the crew hold), a pass-through Sortie (two Hermite legs, never zero speed at the spot), one At-rest blue blip at the ship's live point in the act, plate rides NOTE_MIN_MS; ledger F2/F2+ rows with undoPass keeping E rows as measured.
decisions: Phases: gather 715, act 1200; tell and land dropped (the blip is the call).
Plate: opens at the act (the blip), fold starts NOTE_MIN_MS later (crewTimes(phases, true)); release for P4 is the fold's end, so a next same-captain turn never cuts it.
Blip lives in the act phase at delay 0, anchored at the ship's live point: at the spot in full motion, at its place under reduced motion, no motion check in the theme.
After the pass the ship flies to its live goal over the act's length; a waiting next sortie takes over from its live point (runner hand-off); waitS is ignored by a pass Sortie.
Ledger: undoPass in pacing-ledger.ts; E rows and C2 candidates run with F2 undone so they don't move; F2 and F2+ rows include Meteor (all: true).
